blocks.text: Jab kisi cheez ko garam kiya jaye to woh chamakne lagti hai aur radiation (shuaon) ki shakal mein energy chhorti hai. Yeh radiation sirf cheez ke temperature par munhasir hai, us ke maddey (material) ya shakal par nahi. Temperature barhne par cheez ka rang halka surkh, phir chamakdar peela aur phir safed ho jata hai. Is ka matlab hai ke radiation lambi wavelengths (infrared) se chhoti wavelengths (ultraviolet) ki taraf khisak rahi hai. Lekin asal cheezen saari radiation poori tarah jazb (absorb) ya kharij (emit) nahi karti, is liye un ka theek mutala mushkil hai. Is ko samajhne ke liye scientists aik misali (ideal) cheez farz karte hain jise blackbody kehte hain.

blocks.title: Blackbody
blocks.text: Blackbody woh cheez hai jo us par parne wali saari radiation jazb kar leti hai aur tamam wavelengths par radiation poori tarah kharij bhi karti hai.

Asal zindagi mein blackbody ki achhi misal aik khokhla dabba (hollow cavity) hai jis mein chhota sa soorakh ho aur andar ki deewarein kaali hon (Fig. 21.3). Andar ki deewaron par kaala carbon (kalikh, soot) laga hota hai taake woh radiation achhi tarah jazb karein aur andar hi andar mun'akis (reflect) karein.

blocks.alt: Moti kaali gol deewar jis ke daen taraf chhota soorakh hai. Aik shua soorakh se andar aa kar baar baar mun'akis hoti hai; us ka raasta nau-konay sitare jaisa banta hai aur woh bahar nahi nikal pati.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.3: mukammal ya misali blackbody (kitab ki Figure 21.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jab radiation chhote soorakh se andar aati hai to andar takrati rehti hai aur qaid ho jati hai. Agar is cavity ko kafi zyada temperature tak garam karein to yeh tamam wavelengths ki radiation kharij karne lagti hai. Isi ko blackbody radiation kehte hain. Is radiation ka pattern sirf blackbody ke temperature par munhasir hai. Temperature barhne par kharij hone wali energy bhi barhti hai. Jab hum is radiation ki intensity (shiddat) ko wavelength ke muqable graph par banate hain (Fig. 21.4) to dekhte hain ke temperature barhne par curve ki chotti (peak) chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisakti hai. Yani zyada garam blackbody chhoti wavelengths par zyada energy kharij karti hai.

blocks.alt: Wavelength (0 se 3.0 micrometre) ke muqable radiation intensity ka graph, T = 5000, 4000, 3000 aur 2000 K ke liye. Har curve chotti tak uth kar ahista girta hai; garam curve ooncha aur chhoti wavelength par chotti wala. Chottiyon ke nuqte neeli lakeer se jure hain. Dashed lakeeron ke darmiyan visible hissa rangeen hai, baen Ultraviolet aur daen Infrared; mehwar par lambda max ke nishan.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.4: blackbody radiation ke spectra (kitab ki Figure 21.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har curve ki chotti (λmax) Wien ke law λmax T = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K se aati hai: 5000 K par taqreeban 0.58 μm, 4000 K par 0.72 μm, 3000 K par 0.97 μm aur 2000 K par 1.45 μm. Kitab ke graph mein chottiyan thori baen taraf chhapi hain (maslan 2000 K ki taqreeban 1.2 μm par); hum ne inhein sahi jagah lagaya hai. Curves ki oonchai sirf andaza hai, scale par nahi.

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Blackbody radiation ko poori tarah jazb aur kharij karti hai. Cosmic microwave background (kainat mein har taraf se aane wali halki microwave radiation) ka spectrum taqreeban bilkul blackbody jaisa hai. Hum insan bhi infrared mein blackbody radiation kharij karte hain, isi liye night-vision camera andhere mein hamein dekh lete hain. (Kitab microwave oven ko bhi ginti hai; lekin oven ki microwaves magnetron se aik hi frequency par aati hain, garam cheez ki blackbody radiation se nahi. Kitab 'night-vision bat' likhti hai; yahan night-vision camera samjhein.)

blocks.prompt: Do cheezen mukhtalif temperature tak garam ki jati hain. Aik surkh-garam (red-hot) aur doosri safed-garam (white-hot) chamakti hai. Kaun zyada garam hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Safed-garam cheez zyada garam hai. Us ki chotti chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisak gayi hai, is liye woh poore visible hisse (surkh se banafshi tak) mein tez roshni deti hai jo mil kar safed lagti hai. Surkh-garam cheez zyada tar lambi (surkh) wavelengths par roshni deti hai.

blocks.text: Sooraj jaise stars blackbody radiator ki tarah kaam karte hain. Yeh nuclear fusion (halke nuclei ke mil kar bhari nucleus banne) se apni energy khud banate hain, aur yeh energy electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein space mein phailti hai. Star ki radiation wavelengths ki bari range mein hoti hai aur aik continuous spectrum (baghair khali jagah ke musalsal spectrum) banati hai. Yeh spectrum blackbody spectrum jaisa hota hai. Spectrum parh kar scientists star ki surface ka temperature theek andaza laga lete hain. Har star ka apna spectrum hai, is liye har star ki surface ka temperature bhi alag hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Jaise hi aap mobile phone on karte hain, global positioning system (GPS) aap ki location foran maloom kar sakta hai.
Wien's displacement law blackbody ki surface ke temperature T aur us wavelength λmax ka talluq batata hai jis par woh sab se zyada intensity se radiation kharij karti hai. Is law ke mutabiq:

blocks.title: Wien's Displacement Law
blocks.text: Blackbody jis wavelength par sab se zyada intensity ki radiation kharij karti hai, woh wavelength us ki surface ke temperature ke inversely proportional (ulta mutanasib: temperature barhe to wavelength ghate) hai.

Yahan b aik constant hai jise Wien's constant kehte hain; is ki qeemat 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K (metre kelvin) hai. Yeh law batata hai ke blackbody ka temperature barhne par us ki sab se tez radiation ki wavelength chhoti hoti jati hai. Aasan alfaaz mein: garam cheezen chhoti wavelengths par radiation deti hain (neeli ya banafshi nazar aati hain), aur thandi cheezen lambi wavelengths par (surkh ya infrared). Isi se garam hoti cheez ka rang badalna samajh aata hai, aur isi se stars aur doosri radiation dene wali cheezon ka temperature maloom hota hai.

blocks.title: Wien's constant ki unit
blocks.text: Kitab b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ 'mK' likhti hai. Yahan mK ka matlab metre × kelvin (m K) hai, millikelvin nahi.

blocks.title: Example 21.3
blocks.problem: Aik star ki surface ka temperature 6000 K hai aur us ki radiation ki peak wavelength 480 nm hai. Doosre star ki peak wavelength 320 nm hai. Doosre star ki surface ka temperature maloom karein.
steps: Diya gaya: star-1 ka temperature T₁ = 6000 K, star-1 ki peak wavelength λmax1 = 480 nm, star-2 ki peak wavelength λmax2 = 320 nm; maloom karna hai T₂ = ?
Wien's law: λmax T = b, aur b dono stars ke liye aik hi hai
Is liye λmax1 T₁ = λmax2 T₂, yani T₂ = λmax1 T₁ / λmax2
blocks.answer: Star-2 ki surface ka temperature 9000 K hai (chhoti peak wavelength, zyada garam star).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 21.3 ke hal mein kitab star-1 ka temperature T₁ = 5800 K likhti hai, jab ke sawal mein 6000 K diya hai aur hisaab bhi 6000 K se kiya gaya hai. Sahi T₁ = 6000 K hai; jawab 9000 K theek hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar star ki peak wavelength chhoti ho to yeh us ke temperature ke bare mein kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh zyada garam hai, kyunke λmax T = b (constant): λmax chhota to T bara.

items: Blackbody: saari radiation jazb, tamam wavelengths par kharij; misal: chhote soorakh wali kaali cavity.
Temperature barhe to peak chhoti wavelength ki taraf; stars blackbody jaise.
Wien's law: λmax T = b (21.3), b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K.
